RagShortTexts: The Bohun dynasty held the hereditary Constableship of England, dominating the rugged Welsh.

Variants.Content: Commanding the Welsh borderlands from Severn castles, the Bohuns served as hereditary Constables of England. Governing Hereford and Essex, Humphrey de Bohun emerged as a decisive baronial voice shaping the Provisions of Oxford and crown reform.
The Constable's seal verified royal feudal muster rolls, giving the Earl of Hereford immense leverage over Plantagenet military operations.
